title: PUFAS PARTICIPATING IN NEURODEGENERATIVE DISORDERS AND MUSCLE DISEASES
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide methods for treating Alzheimer's disease, mild cognitive impairment, frontotemporal dementia, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis and/or multiple sclerosis.SOLUTION: The method comprises administration to a patient of an effective amount of a polyunsaturated substance such as fatty acids, fatty acid mimetics, fatty acid prodrugs or fatty acid prodrug esters. The polyunsaturated substance is modified at a bis-allylic position with aC atom, a deuterium atom etc. at a significantly higher level than the naturally occurring abundance level of such an isotope to attenuate damage by reactive oxygen species (ROS) and/or to suppress the rate of formation of reactive products and toxic compounds.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1A
